blockingFindings.title: R4 lacks production-behavior coverage
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires autoApprove and requires_approval decisions to be evaluated only after the explicit target guard passes, but the only R4 test checks textual ordering in src/skills/senti.flow/SKILL.md. An implementation could still evaluate next-action approval behavior before the guard and these tests would not detect it.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local executable mismatch test that puts the active flow on an approval/requires_approval path with autoApprove enabled or disabled as relevant, invokes the guarded dispatcher command with a mismatched explicit target, and asserts ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH with no approval/autoApprove outcome or mutation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a must requirement with no corresponding production regression coverage; the current test exercises guidance text rather than the dispatcher behavior required by R4.
